notes:
Fixed: Purchase Register showing no data when uploaded to Reconciliation.

Root cause: Reconciliation matches invoices by GSTIN, and silently skips any row with a blank one — if a vendor's ledger in Tally has no GSTIN saved under Set/Alter GST Details, every one of that vendor's purchases vanished from the file with no visible reason.

• Purchase GST Summary now tells you exactly which vendors are missing a GSTIN in Tally (and how many invoices were excluded because of it) right after building the register, instead of handing you a file that silently reconciles nothing.
• Vendor name matching between Tally's vouchers and its ledger master is now whitespace/case-tolerant, so a GSTIN that was saved but missed due to a formatting mismatch is no longer dropped.
